decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship central to the firm's enterprise messaging direction, the heavy investment and visible commitment make continuation highly likely despite the lack of recent website observations.

Document capture supports the electronic document workflow strategy and had a dedicated page, so sunk investment and strategic fit favor persistence, though it is more peripheral than the core messaging offers.
Email and fax conversion extends the core multichannel messaging business at low marginal cost, and its weak visibility is more plausibly read as a mature, quiet offer than as failure.
The feature is cheap to maintain next to the established fax service, but its low visibility and the declining relevance of fax make it a candidate for quiet absorption into the base offer.
Sandbox threat protection underpins the security positioning the firm names as a key competitive argument, so commitment and strategic centrality strongly support keeping it.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a baseline expectation of compliance-focused email customers, so withdrawing it would undermine the firm's security story even if it is rebranded or bundled.
